A different number of longitudinal impact test can be conducted if agreed upon betwaen the purchaser and the manufacturer. 8.2.3.2 Transverse impact test shall be carried out in accordance hot rolled kellys or if required specifically by the purchaser. with IS : 1499-1977 in case of

8.2.4 Hardness test - Hardness test shall be carried out in accordance with IS : 1500-1983 ` Method for brine11 hardness test for metallic materials ( second revision )' . Five readings shall be made, one at each end and three more equally spaced along the length of kelly.
